beats.care: Rain won't ruin pandal plans, but highs stay near 31–32°C. Carry water and take breaks when walking.
beats.what: IMD's Kolkata-Alipur forecast shows partly cloudy skies on Sunday, then mostly clear days till October 23. No warnings are listed.
beats.why: The monsoon has pulled out of most of West Bengal. Earlier forecasts had warned of showers around Panchami and Shashthi.
